Record the time value: Operating time for diff. element for phase R

Introduction

Abdel Nasser Maarouf Ahmed, Technical Advisor for Electrical Maintenance, endorsed by Eng. Ibrahim El-Shahat Ibrahim, Head of the Sector, and documented by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Head of the Quality Sector and MPIS Coordinator at the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Open a work order and provide occupational safety and health category cards.
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
The unit is shut down and the generator is out of service.
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Test comb, Test Plug type HP2-C4
AC V-A voltage measuring instrument, type YOKOGAWA
Millisecond Counter (Timer), type MCS-5N
Voltage injection set, type PHU 1040
Test leads
Procedures to be Carried Out
Set the Change-over switch (43), type BH-H7, for testing the (87B) protection to the Test position on the protection cubicle | 1.
Remove the outer cover of the relay and clean the relay with the air blower | 2.
Place Test plug type HP2-C4 in Test socket type HR2A-P4 of the relay (87B) on the protection cubicle | 3.
Place the Pin in SV(0) on the relay (87BA) for phase R | 4.
Inject voltage at points (24,21) in the Test plug | 5.
Raise the voltage until the signal appears on the relay | 6.
Record the voltage value: Operating value for diff. element | 7.
Remove the Pin from SV(0) on the relay (87BA) for phase R | 8.
Place the Pin in Diff(0) on the relay (87BA) for phase R | 9.
Inject voltage at points (24,21) in the Test plug | 10.
Raise the voltage until the signal appears on the relay | 11.
Record the voltage value: Operating value for SV element | 12.
Remove the Pin from Diff.(0) on the relay (87BA) for phase R | 13.
Connect the Start (dry contact) terminals from the timer to terminals T1,T2 on the PHU 1040 voltage injection set | 14.
Connect the Stop (dry contact) terminals from the timer to points 17,18 on the relay (87BA) from the back | 15.
Inject voltage at points (24,21) in the Test plug, of value (2x setting value = 500V) for phase R | 16.
Disconnect the injection set | 17.
Reset the timer | 18.
Connect the injection set | 19.
Record the time value: Operating time for diff. element for phase R | 20.
Reset the timer | 21.
Disconnect the injection set | 22.
Record the time value: Operating time for diff. element for phase R | 23.
Remove the Stop terminals connected to the timer from points 17,18 on the relay (87BA) from the back | 24.
Connect the Stop terminals from the timer to points 19,20 on the relay (87BA) from the back | 25.
Inject voltage at points (24,21) in the Test plug, of value (2x setting value = 80V) for phase R | 26.
Disconnect the injection set | 27.
Reset the timer | 28.
Connect the injection set | 29.
Record the time value: Operating time for SV element for phase R | 30.
Reset the timer | 31.
Disconnect the injection set | 32.
Record the time value: Operating time for SV element for phase R | 33.
Repeat steps (4 to 33) for phase S, changing the injection points to 24,22 in the Test plug | 34.
Repeat steps (4 to 33) for phase T, changing the injection points to 24,22 in the Test plug | 35.
Place the glass cover on the relay | 36.
Remove the HP2-C4 Test plug from the Test socket of the protection cubicle | 37.
Reset the relay (87B) | 38.
Reset the (Lock out relay) of the relay (87B) | 39.
Set the Change-over switch (43), type BH-H7, for testing the (87B) protection to the Normal position on the protection cubicle | 40.
